description_en: Queries the details of a specified application template, including the status of each switch, the action for unidentified applications, and the list of built-in application actions
description_zh: 查询指定应用程序模板的详细信息，包括各开关状态、未识别应用动作和内置应用动作列表
name: GetApplicationTemplate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application template to query. The template must exist within the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的应用程序模板ID。必须为当前阿里云账号下已存在的模板
parameters.name: application_template_id

parameters.help_en:
The return scope for built-in application actions. Valid values:
Custom: returns only applications whose actions have been customized by the user. This is the default value.
All: returns all built-in applications.
The priority of action effectiveness is: user customization > template default > application library default
parameters.help_zh:
内置应用动作的返回范围。取值：
Custom：仅返回用户自定义过动作的应用，为默认值。
All：返回全部内置应用。
动作生效优先级为：用户自定义 > 模板默认 > 应用库默认
parameters.name: built_in_application_action_type

ApplicationTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the application template

ApplicationTemplateName.description_en: The name of the application template

BuiltInApplicationActions.description_en: The list of built-in application actions

Action.description_en:
The action performed on the application. Valid values:
Allow: Allows the traffic.
Alert: Monitors the traffic.
Deny: Blocks the traffic
Action.description_zh:
对该应用程序执行的动作。取值：
Allow：放行。
Alert：观察。
Deny：拦截

ApplicationId.description_en: The ID of the application in the built-in application signature library
ApplicationId.description_zh: 内置应用特征库中的应用程序ID

BuiltInApplicationStatus.description_en:
The switch status for built-in application control. Valid values:
Enable: Enabled.
Disable: Disabled
BuiltInApplicationStatus.description_zh:
内置应用管控开关状态。取值：
Enable：开启。
Disable：关闭

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the application template. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 应用程序模板的创建时间。Unix时间戳，单位为秒

CustomRuleStatus.description_en:
The switch status for custom application rules. Valid values:
Enable: Enabled.
Disable: Disabled
CustomRuleStatus.description_zh:
应用程序自定义规则开关状态。取值：
Enable：开启。
Disable：关闭

Description.description_en: The description of the application template
Description.description_zh: 应用程序模板的描述信息

TemplateStatus.description_en:
The overall switch status of the application template. Valid values:
Enable: Enabled.
Disable: Disabled
TemplateStatus.description_zh:
应用程序模板总开关状态。取值：
Enable：开启。
Disable：关闭

UnknownAction.description_en:
The action for unidentified applications. Valid values:
Allow: Allows the traffic.
Alert: Monitors the traffic.
Deny: Blocks the traffic
UnknownAction.description_zh:
未识别应用的处置动作。取值：
Allow：放行。
Alert：观察。
Deny：拦截

UpdateTime.description_en: The last update time of the application template. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 应用程序模板的最近修改时间。Unix时间戳，单位为秒
